briefing.headline: Harbour's first-half pressing and left-side overload gave way to a more balanced second half as Kestrel recovered territory and scored a late equaliser.

first_half.text: Harbour dominated territory and attacks down their left, registering the vast majority of entries and share on that side while generating the better chance total and xG.
That dominance was built on an aggressive high press and frequent high regains, forcing Kestrel into deep and narrow defending.
Kestrel were limited to sporadic counter chances mainly down their right flank and had very low chance output and xG.

changes.text: Kestrel shifted to greater central and right-side progression, increasing their centre and right-channel entries and substantially lifting their final-third entries and xG in the second half.
Harbour relaxed their press and retreated slightly from left-side overload: their PPDA rose and left-channel entries and channel share fell after the break.
Territory swung toward Kestrel in the middle and final third as possession distribution and centre-channel share moved in their favour.

predictions.text: Harbour would cut Kestrel's right-channel entries by at least 30%, but Kestrel's right-channel entries rose after the break.
Harbour's press intensity would ease and their PPDA would rise by at least 20%, which occurred.
Harbour would increase final-third entries by at least 20%, but their final-third entry rate fell after the break.
Kestrel would cut Harbour's high regains by at least 30%, but Harbour's high regains per-window barely changed.
Kestrel would gain at least a 10% possession rise, but their possession barely increased.
Kestrel would blunt Harbour's left flank and reduce Harbour's left-channel entries by at least 30%, which happened.

result.text: Harbour's first-half pressure produced the opening goal, reflected in their higher early chance volume and xG, but they could not maintain the same volume after the break.
Kestrel's second-half adjustment — more centre progression, more entries and a jump in xG — delivered an equaliser and forced the draw.
Overall the game swung from Harbour-controlled pressure and left-side overload to a more balanced second half where Kestrel grew into the game and salvaged a 1-1 finish.
